publicComment.summary: Go to the meeting, fill out a speaker card (the agenda calls it a City Council Appearance Card), and give it to a staff member or place it on the City Secretary's desk at the front of the chambers before the Public Comment item comes up; you get up to 3 minutes. Comments about a public hearing item are heard when that hearing starts. If you would rather write in, use the online City Council Public Comment Form by 3 p.m. on meeting day; it will be acknowledged at the meeting, and attached to the minutes if you ask for it to be on the record.
publicComment.howToRegister: In person: complete a speaker card (choose only one option: general public comment or a specific public hearing item) and hand it to a staff member or put it on the City Secretary's desk before the Public Comment item on the agenda; address remarks to the presiding officer. Written: submit the City Council Public Comment Form linked from the City Secretary page (hosted on openforms.com) by 3 p.m. the day of the meeting.
publicComment.deadline: In person: before the Public Comment item on the agenda; online form: 3 p.m. on the day of the meeting
publicComment.writtenCommentMethod: Online City Council Public Comment Form (via addisontx.gov City Secretary page, hosted at us.openforms.com); comments requested for the record are attached to the minutes, other comments are acknowledged during the meeting but not read aloud
publicComment.notes: The Public Comment Procedures page and the Sept 8, 2026 agenda describe only in-person speaker cards and written submissions, so remote speaking is treated as not offered; confirm with the City Secretary (972-450-7000) if you need it. Public comment appears on both the work session and the council meeting agenda. Decorum rules: no placards, banners or signs in the chambers; no personal, profane or slanderous remarks; the council cannot discuss or act on topics that are not on the agenda but may put them on a future agenda.

cities.notes: The old domain addisontexas.net now redirects to addisontx.gov, which relaunched in 2026 on OpenCities; several older pages return 404 and the site's calendar needs JavaScript. The council previously met at the Addison TreeHouse (14681 Midway Road, Suite 200) during a Town Hall renovation, but that notice is no longer online and all current pages and the Sept 8, 2026 agenda list Town Hall. The Sept 22, 2026 agenda was not yet posted on Sept 10 (agendas post three business days ahead), so no agenda items are listed; the Sept 8 agenda (already past) covered the FY2027 budget and a $0.5981 tax rate, utility and solid waste fee increases, and a 380-unit Belt Line Road rezoning. publicComment.summary: Sign up online with the Public Speaker Request Form (it opens at 5 p.m. the Friday before the meeting and closes at 5 p.m. on meeting day) or fill out a paper Public Meeting Appearance Card at City Hall and give it to the City Secretary before the 7 p.m. meeting. You can speak on any topic not on the agenda for up to 3 minutes during Citizens' Comments (15 minutes total for all speakers), but the council cannot vote that night on things that are not on the agenda.
publicComment.howToRegister: 1) Online: open the Public Speaker Request Form between 5 p.m. Friday before the meeting and 5 p.m. on meeting day and enter your name, address and topic. 2) In person: pick up a paper Public Meeting Appearance Card in the Council Chambers at 305 Century Parkway and hand it to the City Secretary before the meeting begins. 3) When called, go to the podium, state your name and address for the record, and speak; groups should choose one spokesperson.
publicComment.deadline: Online form closes at 5 p.m. on meeting day; paper cards accepted until the meeting is called to order at 7 p.m.
publicComment.writtenCommentMethod: No dedicated written-comment form is published; email the City Secretary, Shelley George (sgeorge@allentx.gov, 214-509-4105), to have comments forwarded to the council.
publicComment.notes: The Sept. 8, 2026 agenda states: 'The City Council invites citizens to speak to the Council on any topic not on the agenda or not already scheduled for Public Hearing. Prior to the meeting, please complete a Public Meeting Appearance Card and present it to the City Secretary. The time limit is three minutes per speaker, not to exceed a total of fifteen minutes for all speakers.' Speakers on agenda items and public hearings are heard when that item comes up. Council may refer non-agenda issues to staff or a future agenda but cannot act on them the same night. Sign interpreters or special services: call the City Secretary at 214-509-4105 at least 48 hours ahead.

publicComment.howToRegister: 1) Find the meeting on agenda.friscotexas.gov and note whether your topic is a posted agenda item (up to 5 minutes, 10 with a translator) or a non-agenda topic (only allowed when Citizen Input is on that meeting's agenda). 2) Go to the Council Chambers at the George A.
